changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwpayor AS SELECT p.id, p.code, p.name, p.category, p.address, p.phone, p.email, p.contract_manager_contact, p.start_date, p.expiry_date, p.renewable, p.allow_partial_coverage, p.accept_copay, p.accept_deductibles, p.allow_package_pricing, p.allow_drg_billing, p.force_preapproval, p.is_active, p.created_date, p.created_by, p.last_modified_by, p.last_modified_date, p.nphies_id, p.waseel_payer_id, p.tpa_nphies_id, p.is_waseel_enabled FROM public.payor p;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwpayor TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwpayor FROM report_user;
